usedFor: New Airtable records can be posted to a Slack channel or sent as an approval request.

bestTemplate.name: “New Records Appear” in Airtable, then “Send Interactive Message” in Slack
bestTemplate.why: Buttons or a form let people respond in Slack, which beats a plain notice for approvals.

watchOut: “New Records Appear” polls, and on 50agents a Slack channel post waits for your approval.
